name: 81-ieltxu
description: Ieltxu: a near-black night bird with broad spread wings, a dark purple-black body, a hooked beak and small dark red eyes. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Hovering in place, one wingbeat: both broad dark wings sweep up high, then beat down low, then back. Body and head steady. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
